study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
exposure: position of the center of the gestational sac
outcome: Stage of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorder
cohort: 187 women with vasa previa, placenta previa, and at least one previous Cesarean delivery or uterine surgery
finding: Early first-trimester sonographic assessment of pregnancies with previous CD can reliably predict the ultrasound stage of PAS disorder, and the combination of findings on first-trimester ultrasound with second- and third-trimester ultrasound examination can stratify the surgical risk in women affected by a PAS disorder.
